title: bank of canada / monetary policy / rate decision | Monetary Policy Report | Monetary Policy Report—January 2026
summary: The Bank of Canada held its target overnight rate at 2.25% (Bank Rate 2.5%, deposit rate 2.20%) amid elevated US tariff disruption and trade uncertainty. The Canadian economy is expected to grow at approximately 1.25% over the projection horizon while CPI inflation remains near the 2% target, with excess supply roughly offsetting upward cost pressures. The outlook is characterized by unusually high risks due to geopolitical uncertainty and the ongoing review of the Canada-United States-Mexico Agreement.
